```{r setup, include = FALSE}
has_bus <- exists("rxEventListen", asNamespace("rxode2"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  eval = has_bus
)
# everything `:=` and saveFit() write goes to a scratch directory
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = tempfile("nlmixr2save-events-"))
if (has_bus) dir.create(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"))
```

```{r, eval = !has_bus, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
cat("> **Note:** the installed `rxode2` has no event bus",
    "(`rxode2::rxEventListen()` does not exist), so the code in this",
    "vignette is shown but not run.  `nlmixr2save` emits nothing in that",
    "case; `:=` and `saveFit()` work exactly as before.\n")
```

`nlmixr2save` tells loggers *what was assigned*: when `fit := nlmixr2(...)`
finishes, a logger learns that the result was named `fit`, whether it came from
the cache, and the hash it was stored under.  It does this by reporting to the
`rxode2` event bus.

## The event bus in one paragraph

`rxode2` provides a small publish/subscribe mechanism: packages call
`rxode2::rxEventEmit(event, ...)` when a top-level operation finishes, and any
function registered with `rxode2::rxEventListen(id, fun)` is called as
`fun(event, ...)` with the payload fields as named arguments.  Events are only
delivered from the outermost operation (scope depth 0), so the fits inside a
bootstrap or the solves inside a fit are silent.  See `?rxode2::rxEventListen`
for the full API (`rxEventScope()`, `rxEventDepth()`, `rxEventSeq()`, ...).

Other packages emit the events that describe the *work* (`fitComplete` from
`nlmixr2est::nlmixr2()`, `solveComplete` from `rxode2::rxSolve()`, ...).
`nlmixr2save` emits the events that describe the *assignment* around that work.
Every emitter checks that the bus exists first, so with an older `rxode2`
nothing is emitted and nothing breaks.

## Events emitted by nlmixr2save

| Function         | Events                                          |
|------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| `x := value`     | `assignStart`, then `assign` or `assignAbort`   |
| `saveFit(fit)`   | `assign` (only outside `:=`, only for a fit)    |

### `assignStart`

Emitted by `:=` before anything is evaluated or loaded, so a logger can
attribute every event that follows (a `fitComplete`, a `solveComplete`) to the
name being assigned.

| Field  | Meaning                                                     |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| `name` | The name on the left of `:=` (`NULL` if it is not a symbol) |

### `assign`

Emitted by `:=` when it returns successfully, whether the value was computed or
restored from the cache.

| Field    | Meaning                                                                                                   |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `name`   | The name assigned (same as in `assignStart`)                                                              |
| `value`  | The value assigned (a fit, a simulation, a data frame, ...)                                               |
| `call`   | The right-hand side of `:=`, normalized by `rxode2` so it never embeds large values                       |
| `envir`  | The environment the name was assigned in                                                                  |
| `cached` | `TRUE` when the value was restored from disk instead of computed                                          |
| `sha`    | The hash the value is cached under (`NULL` in trusted-cache mode, `options(nlmixr2save.check = FALSE)`)   |
| `random` | `TRUE` when the right-hand side is a random/simulation function (`rxSolve()`, `vpcSim()`, ...)            |
| `seed`   | For a random result, the random seed captured before it ran; `NULL` otherwise                             |
| `since`  | `rxode2::rxEventSeq()` just after `assignStart`; events delivered after it belong to this assignment      |

`since` lets a logger collect the events produced by the right-hand side: every
event whose sequence number is greater than `since` and that was delivered
before this `assign` belongs to it.

### `assignAbort`

Emitted by `:=` when the right-hand side (or the saving) errors.  The only field
is `name`.  A logger can drop whatever it collected since the matching
`assignStart`.

### `assign` from `saveFit()`

A direct `saveFit()` of an `nlmixr2` fit reports an `assign` after the fit is
written, with the same fields:

- `name` is the `file` argument when given, otherwise the name of the variable
  passed as `fit` (`saveFit(fit)` reports `"fit"`);
- `cached = FALSE`, `random = FALSE`, and `sha`, `seed` and `since` are `NULL`;
- there is no `assignStart` and no `assignAbort`: a `saveFit()` that errors
  emits nothing.

**`saveFit()` vs `:=`.**  When `:=` saves a fit it calls `saveFit()` internally;
that inner `saveFit()` is silent and only the `:=` reports.  So every saved fit
is reported exactly once: by `:=` when it was assigned with `:=`, otherwise by
`saveFit()`.  `saveFit()` of anything that is not a fit (for example a plain
list) emits nothing.

## What is not emitted

- **Hash evaluations.**  To build its cache key, `:=` evaluates the arguments of
  the right-hand side (or, for `nlmixr2()`, the estimation properties).  That
  evaluation runs inside an event scope, so in
  `a := augPred(nlmixr2(model, data, est = "posthoc"))` the fit computed only to
  hash the call is silent; only the fit that produces the value reports a
  `fitComplete`.
- **Cache hits produce no work events.**  When the value is restored from disk,
  the right-hand side is not run, so the sequence is just `assignStart` and
  `assign` with `cached = TRUE`.
- **Anything inside another operation's scope.**  A `:=` that runs inside a fit,
  a solve or any other scoped operation emits nothing, like every other event.

### Nested `:=`

A `:=` evaluated while another `:=` is running its right-hand side (for example
inside a function called on the right) reports normally, and its `assign`
arrives before the outer one:

```
assignStart(outer) -> assignStart(inner) -> assign(inner) -> assign(outer)
```

The outer `:=` saves and restores its own state around the inner one, so the
outer `assign` still carries its own `sha`, and an inner `saveFit()` inside
either one stays silent.

## Listening

A listener is any `function(event, ...)`.  This one just records what it is
told:

```{r listen}
library(nlmixr2save)
library(nlmixr2est)

events <- new.env()
events$log <- list()
rxode2::rxEventListen("demo", function(event, ...) {
  p <- list(...)
  events$log[[length(events$log) + 1L]] <- list(event = event, payload = p)
})
seen <- function() {
  vapply(events$log, function(e) {
    if (is.null(e$payload$name)) e$event else paste0(e$event, "(", e$payload$name, ")")
  }, character(1))
}
```

A small model to fit:

```{r model}
one <- function() {
  ini({
    tka <- log(1.57); tcl <- log(2.72); tv <- log(31.5)
    eta.ka ~ 0.6; eta.cl ~ 0.3; eta.v ~ 0.1
    add.sd <- 0.7
  })
  model({
    ka <- exp(tka + eta.ka)
    cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl)
    v <- exp(tv + eta.v)
    linCmt() ~ add(add.sd)
  })
}
```

The first `:=` runs the fit.  When the installed `nlmixr2est` has the event
hooks, its `fitComplete` arrives between the two `nlmixr2save` events
(`assignStart(fit)`, `fitComplete`, `assign(fit)`); with an `nlmixr2est`
without them only the two `nlmixr2save` events are seen:

```{r fit1, results = "hide"}
fit := nlmixr2(one, nlmixr2data::theo_sd, est = "posthoc",
               control = list(print = 0))
```

```{r fit1b}
seen()
a <- events$log[[length(events$log)]]$payload
a$cached
a$sha
as.call(as.list(a$call)) # the right-hand side of `:=`
```

Running it again restores the fit from `fit.zip`; nothing is fit, so only the
assignment is reported:

```{r fit2}
events$log <- list()
fit := nlmixr2(one, nlmixr2data::theo_sd, est = "posthoc",
               control = list(print = 0))
seen()
events$log[[2]]$payload$cached
```

A simulation is flagged as random and carries the seed it started from:

```{r sim, results = "hide"}
events$log <- list()
ev <- rxode2::et(amt = 320) |> rxode2::et(0:24)
set.seed(42)
sim := rxode2::rxSolve(fit, ev, nSub = 2)
```

```{r simb}
seen()
a <- events$log[[length(events$log)]]$payload
a$random
!is.null(a$seed)
a$since
```

An error on the right-hand side reports `assignAbort`:

```{r abort}
events$log <- list()
try(bad := nlmixr2(one, nlmixr2data::theo_sd, est = "notAnEst"), silent = TRUE)
seen()
```

A direct `saveFit()` reports one `assign` named after the file:

```{r savefit}
events$log <- list()
saveFit(fit, "fitCopy")
seen()
```

And a nested `:=`:

```{r nested}
events$log <- list()
inner <- function() {
  y := data.frame(b = 2)
  data.frame(c = 3)
}
outer := inner()
seen()
```

Remove the listener when done:

```{r unlisten}
rxode2::rxEventUnlisten("demo")
```

## Stable fit keys

`:=` caches a result built on a fit (`sim := rxSolve(fit, ev)`,
`a := augPred(fit)`) under a hash of its arguments.  Serializing a fit to hash
it is not stable: a fit reloaded from its zip in a new session differs
byte-wise from the fresh one (loader fields, delayed bindings, tables that went
through a csv file).  So `:=` hashes a fit on its right-hand side with
`nlmixr2saveFitKey()` instead, and that result is a cache hit in a new session
too.  Both keys are lists meant to be hashed, and neither forces nor writes
anything in the fit.

- `nlmixr2saveFitIdentity(fit)` says *which* fit it is: the model (normalized
  model, error lines and initial estimates table), the estimation method, the
  fixed effects, the `omega` matrix and the data.  It is the same for a fit,
  its `saveFit()`/`loadFit()` reload, and the fit after `addCwres()`.
- `nlmixr2saveFitKey(fit)` adds everything a downstream result could depend
  on: the column names, the objective function rows and values, the covariance
  and its method, the table values, and (with `sha = TRUE`, the default) the
  hash `:=` stored on the fit.

Numbers are rounded to 10 to 12 significant digits so a csv round trip does
not change the keys.  What invalidates a `:=` cache built on a fit is anything
that changes `nlmixr2saveFitKey()`:

| Change to the fit                                  | Identity | Key (invalidates `:=`) |
|----------------------------------------------------|----------|------------------------|
| `saveFit()` then `loadFit()`, a new R session       | same     | same                   |
| `addCwres()`, `addNpde()`, `addTable()` (new columns) | same   | changes                |
| `setOfv()` (new objective function row)            | same     | changes                |
| a new covariance (`preconditionFit()`, ...)        | same     | changes                |
| different estimates, data, model or method         | changes  | changes                |

```{r keys}
fit2 <- loadFit("fitCopy")
identical(digest::digest(nlmixr2saveFitIdentity(fit)),
          digest::digest(nlmixr2saveFitIdentity(fit2)))
identical(digest::digest(nlmixr2saveFitKey(fit, sha = FALSE)),
          digest::digest(nlmixr2saveFitKey(fit2, sha = FALSE)))
```

Loggers can use `nlmixr2saveFitIdentity()` to recognize the same fit across
`fitComplete`, `fitUpdate` and `assign` events, even after it was saved and
reloaded.

## Full logging

To record all of these events (with the fits, simulations and results they
describe) to a log, use the [nlmixr2log](https://github.com/nlmixr2/nlmixr2log)
package, which listens to the bus and turns `assignStart`/`assign` into named
entries.
